reasons.missing-reduced-motion: Everywhere, because superbot's motion is always on: .cosmos/rules/motion-always-on.mdc ("superbot never honours ... a platform Reduce Motion setting ... Operator order, 2026-09-19. Every animation in superbot runs unconditionally"), AGENTS.md, and `npm run audit:motion` fails test:all on any reduced-motion guard. A guard is the defect here. The policy is declared in `.cosmos/rules/motion-always-on.mdc` and AGENTS.md, which check-ui reads per file, climbing to the repo boundary; this allow stays as a belt-and-braces declaration.

A port of superbot-desktop packages/core/src/vendor/context-spans.ts whose semantics and strings are IDENTICAL by contract (its header: "Change the desktop file first, then this one"; the file is byte-identical in two places): the fold summaries `Workspace map · N files` and `Context · N lines` are the app's own strings (the desktop e2e asserts them).

The hero's mock of the app's outcome chip (`worked: '1s · 2 steps'`): the desktop's OUTCOME_SEPARATOR is the user-approved ' · ' (agent-status.ts: "the user-approved ' · ' ... Worked for 27s · 14 steps · 1 denied"). hero-realui.js's header: every surface in frame is the real app's.

The retired V0 hero's own footer (`waited for you 1.4s · nag me`). .cosmos/rules/learned-hero-variants.mdc: V0 retired 2026-09-06, kept for archive/site/lander-agent-v0.html; no live site page loads hero-stage.js.
Not a meta separator: the `·` is a glyph of the textmode background's character ramp ('#', 'o', '·', STATIC_CHARS), drawn onto an aria-hidden canvas.

Not link text: `← → ↻` are the back, forward and reload buttons of the mock browser toolbar (.hw-bar .hw-nav) inside the aria-hidden #hub. ~/.cosmos/rules/mobile-web-design.mdc: "11px window chrome is decoration only".

`✓` (U+2713, a text-presentation dingbat that the checker's U+2600-27BF range sweeps in) is the status tick the product's own terminal prints: cli.html is a captured render of the real CLI (assets/features/manifest.json, cli.ansi), and hero.css `.card .fix`, hub-boot.css `.margin .ln.done` and race.css `.term .ok` draw that transcript in the site's mocks. Not an authored bullet. race.css's real emoji marker (`⚡` before the /superbot badge) was dropped instead.

Not bullets: PLAY_MORPHS and Mascot.emojis are the mascot's own morph glyphs (the ASCII character becomes one on the let's-play beat, design-brief.md Mascot), and `copied ✓` is a copy button's transient confirmation label. A module under ?v= with 20+ importers; changing it buys nothing the check is after.

False positive: the 👀 ends a sentence of the developer-console easter egg (`hey, you opened the console 👀`), printed with console.log to devtools, never rendered in the page and not a list marker. console-hi.js is imported by every page, so an edit would cascade a ?v= bump through all of them.
